title: The harbour
alt: A busy harbour with fishing boats, nets, crates, a crab, people and Cbear in his navy scarf by the net shed.

finds.label: Blue boat
finds.spoken: Find the blue boat on the water.

finds.label: Crab
finds.spoken: Find the crab on the rocks.

finds.label: Red flag
finds.spoken: Find the red flag high on the mast.

finds.label: Fishing net
finds.spoken: Find the fishing net by the crates at the front.

sounds.text: Listen for n in net. Look by the nets.
sounds.spoken: Listen for the n sound in net. Look by the nets.

words.text: Look by the net. Sound out net.
words.spoken: Look by the net. Sound out net: n, e, t.

digraphs.text: Check the shed. Listen for sh in shed.
digraphs.spoken: Check the shed. Listen for sh in shed.

hint: Search at the left edge of the quay, beside the net shed.
